38: Tiered Pricing: what a category's own page shows while it is being moved to another matrix

On a matrix's page in Edit, after a category is picked on the Categories line and before Save is clicked, which matrix does that category's own page (and its row on the Categories list) show?
(a) Still its old matrix, until Save (suggested: your answer and the PRD say its parts are priced by the new matrix only after Save, and Cancel puts the line back, so the rest of Settings would agree with the prices)
(b) The new matrix at once, while its parts still price by the old matrix until Save
(c) Something else (please say).

Your answer 6 says the category "is saved in the picker when picked" but its parts don't price by the matrix until the matrix is saved. The PRD (16 Nov) now says the picked categories show on the matrix's Categories line at once, are priced by the matrix only after Save, and Cancel puts them back. Neither says what the category's own page shows in between. Our tests check the part's price before and after Save; this check is added once you answer.
PRD Story 3 (the matrix page's Categories line); your answer 6 (16 Nov 2026)
39: Tiered Pricing: Change All when a Save only adds a category to a shared matrix

A matrix already prices two or more categories. In Edit, the user only picks one more category (no value in the grid changes) and clicks Save. Does the "Change Prices in [n] Categories?" question (Change All) appear?
(a) No: with no grid value changed it saves without asking, as renaming does (suggested: no rule changes for the categories already on the matrix, and before 16 Nov the PRD said category changes save without asking)
(b) Yes: every Save of a matrix used by more than one category asks it
(c) Something else (please say).

Before 16 Nov the PRD said renaming, changing its categories and turning the Part Sale switch on save without asking. Since 16 Nov it says categories save with the grid, and that saving the grid of a matrix used by more than one category asks the question. It does not say whether a Save that changes only the categories counts. One test waits for your answer.
PRD Story 3 (what asks Change All; the matrix page's Categories line); your answer 6 (16 Nov 2026)
